title: Long-term changes in pituitary gene expression following developmental exposure to contaminants in male mice
author: Mogus, Joshua P
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Expose pregnant mice to chemicals
steps.instruction: Administer bisphenol‑S (BPS), BDE‑47, or TBBPA to pregnant dams from gestation day 8 through weaning at post‑natal day 21 (PND21) at a dose of 0.2 mg per kg body weight per day via maternal circulation and nursing.

steps.title: Collect and freeze pituitaries
steps.instruction: Allow male offspring to mature untreated until post‑natal day 140 (PND140), euthanize, dissect pituitaries, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Isolate total RNA with Trizol
steps.instruction: Extract pituitary RNA using a Trizol protocol, then assess RNA purity and concentration before proceeding to library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare Illumina TruSeq libraries
steps.instruction: Construct mRNA‑seq libraries with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA LP kit (Cat # 20020594) and TruSeq RNA Single‑Index Set B (Cat # 20020493) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq500
steps.instruction: Run the libraries on an Illumina NextSeq500 using a single‑end 76‑cycle run with the NSQ 500/550 Hi Output Kit v2.5 (Cat # 20024906), multiplexing three samples per exposure group (N = 3).

steps.title: Generate FASTQ files
steps.instruction: Obtain compressed FASTQ files representing each sequencing flow‑cell lane (four files per sample). Sample identifiers are coded as X = vehicle control, R = TBBPA, C = BDE‑47, E = BPS.

steps.title: Filter and demultiplex reads
steps.instruction: Perform read filtering, trimming, and demultiplexing using Illumina BaseSpace cloud service (https://basespace.illumina.com/home/index, RRID:SCR_011881).

steps.title: Align reads to mouse genome
steps.instruction: Map processed reads to the mouse reference genome (MM10) with RNA‑Seq Alignment v.1.1.1 using Bowtie 2.

steps.title: Assemble transcripts and test differential expression
steps.instruction: Assemble transcripts and calculate log₂ FPKM ratios with Cufflinks Assembly & DE v.2.1.0; identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs) using a false discovery rate ≤ 0.05 (q ≤ 0.05).

steps.title: Perform Metascape enrichment analysis
steps.instruction: Upload all DEGs to Metascape, run default enrichment settings, and save results as Excel files named <chemical>_<direction>_metascape.xlsx (e.g., BDE‑47_negative_metascape.xlsx).

steps.title: Conduct Ingenuity pathway analysis
steps.instruction: Upload DEGs to Ingenuity Pathway Analysis, run default settings, and record enriched canonical pathways, p‑values, and associated genes in IPA_pathway_analysis.xlsx.
